planningStatus: Historical PD proxy review. The accepted PDX budgets supersede its baseline and rounded guardband as active design loads.

pdx.status: VCCH, VCCL and VDD maximum currents are TBD. No usable public PDX-specific rail-current specification was found in this research.

pd.document: ASMedia ASM2464PD Data Sheet, revision 0.4, May 5 2023
pd.sourceKind: Manufacturer-authored datasheet hosted by a third-party mirror
notes: The table labels these as maximum currents. It supplies no typical or idle currents and no detailed operating-mode/test conditions.
The VCCH figure can vary with GPIO use, according to the datasheet note.
VCCA33 has a separate supply pin but no separate current figure in this table. Do not infer a complete 3.3 V board budget from VCCH alone.

pdxProxy.status: Historical engineering approximation, superseded by the accepted 1 A VCCL, 3 A VDD and combined 100 mA VCCH/VCCA33 budgets. Not an ASMedia PDX current guarantee.
limitations: PDX uses about 1.13 V VDD, whereas the PD document specifies 1.05 V. Retain the PDX voltage requirements.
Current does not transfer exactly between the PD and PDX. The sensitivity multipliers and rounded case are assumptions, not measured or guaranteed bounds.
The 3 A regulator rating remains a stress case, not an estimate of the bridge load.
Startup current and fast current transients are not established by the PD table.
